"use client"; import Link from "next/link"; import { useRouter } from "next/navigation"; import { useEffect, useState } from "react"; import { formatMXN } from "@/src/domain/sales/sale.entity"; import { loadStoreCheckout, saveStoreCheckout, type StoreCheckoutDraft, } from "@/src/infrastructure/sales/store-checkout.storage"; import { ModuleHero } from "@/src/presentation/components/ModuleHero"; import { PageShell } from "@/src/presentation/components/layout/PageShell"; export default function StorePaymentPage() { const router = useRouter(); const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false); const [draft, setDraft] = useState(null); const [selectedMethod, setSelectedMethod] = useState("tarjeta"); useEffect(() => { setDraft(loadStoreCheckout()); setLoaded(true); }, []); const subtotal = draft?.subtotal ?? 0; const iva = draft?.iva ?? 0; const envio = Math.round(subtotal * 0.08 * 100) / 100; const total = (draft?.total ?? 0) + envio; function continueToShipping() { if (!draft || selectedMethod !== "tarjeta") return; saveStoreCheckout({ ...draft, }); router.push("/tienda/pago/envio?metodo=tarjeta"); } return (
{!loaded ? (
